timing_semantics.shadow_oracle: independently instrumented full-fresh pytest per observation; exact node-sequence and per-node non-failure evidence; excluded from every performance metric

timing_semantics.zerorun: primary end-to-end paired total: two current-product transition runs plus the same environment-bootstrap charge and all measured qualification, activation, and ZeroRun seed costs amortized across the fixed 20-transition horizon
